notes: Read all 420 source lines (numbered) before editing. The module is a non-visual utility: a useSyncExternalStore-backed preference store persisted in browser localStorage plus a procedural WebAudio cue player. No JSX, no Recharts/Leaflet, no web UI components — only three browser-coupled globals (localStorage, the window 'storage' event, and WebAudio AudioContext/OscillatorType), each ported behind the established native-parity globalThis-probe precedent (useOnboardingSkip / AIVoiceMode).

L1 `import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'` -> `import {useSyncExternalStore} from 'react'` (react is RN-compatible; useSyncExternalStore runs identically under Hermes; native prettier drops inner-brace spacing).

L3-21 module JSDoc (per-channel notification audio; localStorage persistence with no backend AppSettings field; WebAudio procedural <450ms tonal cues; independence from the useNotificationListener visibility gate; achievement audio still owned by AchievementUnlockListener / useAchievementCelebrationPrefs) preserved verbatim, with one added 'Native parity' paragraph pointing at the file header + nativeNotificationSoundCapabilities. A `//` file header additionally documents the three browser-only substitutions.

L23-33 `NOTIFICATION_SOUND_CATEGORIES` const tuple (critical_alert, warning_alert, info_alert, charge_complete, drive_complete, automation_run, achievement) `as const` and the derived `NotificationSoundCategory` union type ported verbatim.
L35-42 `NotificationSoundPrefs` interface (master:boolean, perCategory:Record<NotificationSoundCategory,boolean>, volume:number) with its three field JSDoc comments ported verbatim.

L44-56 `DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_SOUND_PREFS` ported byte-for-byte — master:false (opt-in), the seven perCategory defaults (critical/warning/charge true; info/drive/automation/achievement false), volume:0.6.
L58 `STORAGE_KEY = 'teslasync:notification-sound-prefs:v1'` preserved exactly (round-trips with the web localStorage payload on the react-native-web target).
L60-65 `clamp(n,min,max)` exported helper ported verbatim — NaN -> min, below -> min, above -> max, else n (matches the web vitest clamp suite incl. NaN).
L67-69 `isCategoryKey` type guard and L71-85 `normalizePerCategory` (default-spread base then overlay only boolean values on valid category keys) ported verbatim.

L87-98 `normalizePrefs` (non-object -> defaults; master boolean-or-default; perCategory via normalizePerCategory; volume number-clamped-to-[0,1]-or-default) ported verbatim; prettier wrapped the master ternary across lines.

L100-109 `readPrefs`: the web `typeof localStorage === 'undefined'` guard is replaced by the native-safe `getWebStorage()` probe (added WebStorageLike interface + getItem/setItem detection off globalThis.localStorage, the AIVoiceMode precedent). Same semantics: no store -> DEFAULT; missing/empty raw -> DEFAULT; JSON.parse -> normalizePrefs; any throw -> DEFAULT. On a pure native runtime the store is absent, exactly mirroring the web non-browser path.

L111-114 the stable snapshot cache (`cachedPrefs = readPrefs()`, `cachedSerialized = JSON.stringify(cachedPrefs)`) and its referential-equality rationale comment preserved verbatim (prevents the React 18 infinite-render).
L116-127 `getSnapshot` and `refreshSnapshot` (re-read, re-serialize, swap only when the serialized form changed) ported verbatim.

L129 `const listeners = new Set<() => void>()` and L131-147 `subscribe`: the browser-only `window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage)` / `removeEventListener` is resolved via the native-safe `getStorageEventTarget()` (added StorageEventLike + StorageEventTargetLike structural types; probes globalThis for addEventListener/removeEventListener). When a target exists (react-native-web) the 'storage' listener is attached/detached verbatim, the `e.key !== STORAGE_KEY` guard + refreshSnapshot()+cb() body unchanged; on a pure native runtime there is no target so cross-surface fan-out folds into the module `listeners` set. The listener add/delete contract is identical.
L149-151 `useNotificationSoundPrefs` -> `useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot)` ported verbatim (same getSnapshot reused as getServerSnapshot).
L153-156 `getNotificationSoundPrefs` synchronous accessor (for SSE callbacks) ported verbatim incl. its JSDoc.
L158-168 `NotificationSoundPrefsPatch` interface + its JSDoc (partial updates, shallow perCategory merge, cross-tab via storage event) ported verbatim.

L170-195 `setNotificationSoundPrefs`: shallow perCategory merge, master/volume patch-or-keep with clamp(volume,0,1), early-return when the serialized form is unchanged. The web `typeof localStorage !== 'undefined'` setItem guard is replaced by `const store = getWebStorage(); if (store) { try { store.setItem(...) } catch { /* quota / private mode */ } }` — identical fall-through-to-in-memory behaviour. `cachedPrefs`/`cachedSerialized` updated and `for (const cb of listeners) cb()` notify preserved exactly, so same-process subscribers are notified without depending on the storage event.
L197-209 `NotificationCategoryInput` interface + its JSDoc (loose SSE alert / web-push shape; both 'warn' and 'warning' accepted) ported verbatim.

L211-247 `mapNotificationToCategory` ported verbatim: explicit lowercased+trimmed category override first; then the kind/type switch (charge_complete|charging_complete -> charge_complete; drive_complete|drive_end|trip_complete -> drive_complete; automation_run|automation -> automation_run; achievement|achievement_unlocked -> achievement); then severity (critical|crit -> critical_alert; warn|warning -> warning_alert; info|notice -> info_alert); then the bare `kind === 'alert'` -> info_alert fallback and null. Matches the web vitest mapping table exactly.

L260-320 `TONE_PROFILES` record ported note-for-note for all seven categories (critical_alert square 0.22 B5->E5; warning_alert triangle 0.18 A5+A5; info_alert sine 0.14 G5 dur .4; charge_complete triangle 0.18 C5->G5; drive_complete triangle 0.16 E5->C5; automation_run sine 0.1 D5 dur .25; achievement triangle 0.18 C5->E5->G5) including every freq/offset/duration and the descriptive comments.

L322-324 `WindowWithLegacyAudio = typeof window & { webkitAudioContext?: ... }` REPLACED by minimal structural WebAudio interfaces (AudioNodeLike, AudioParamLike, OscillatorNodeLike, GainNodeLike, AudioContextLike, AudioContextCtor) because the DOM lib is excluded; these describe exactly the surface playNotificationSound touches (currentTime, destination, createOscillator/createGain, osc.type/frequency.value/connect/start/stop, gain.gain.setValueAtTime/exponentialRampToValueAtTime/connect).

L326-340 `cachedCtx` (typed AudioContextLike|null) + the two test-only hooks `__resetNotificationSoundForTests` (drops cachedCtx) and `__getCachedAudioContextForTests` (returns AudioContextLike|null) ported verbatim with their JSDoc.

L342-346 `resolveAudioContextCtor`: the web `typeof window === 'undefined'` + `window.AudioContext ?? window.webkitAudioContext` is ported as a globalThis probe (`AudioContext ?? webkitAudioContext`, returned only when typeof === 'function', else null) — the AIVoiceMode globalThis-cast precedent. On the react-native-web target this resolves the real constructor; on a pure native runtime it returns null.
L348-357 `PlayResult` interface (played + the six reason literals master_off|category_off|unknown_category|no_audio_context|volume_zero|play_failed) ported verbatim.

L359-406 `playNotificationSound` ported verbatim: master_off / category_off / unknown_category / volume_zero (<=0 after clamp) / no_audio_context gates in order; lazy `cachedCtx = new Ctor()`; per-note oscillator+gain graph with setValueAtTime(0.0001,start), exponentialRampToValueAtTime(max(peak,0.0002),start+0.02) attack and ...(0.0001,start+dur) release, connect chain to ctx.destination, osc.start(start)/stop(start+dur+0.05), peak = profile.peakGain*volume, tail 0.45; returns {played:true} or {played:false,reason:'play_failed'} on any throw — never throws/rejects. Matches the web playNotificationSound vitest suite (note counts, ctor caching, no_audio_context path).

L408-420 `playForNotification` ported verbatim (map input -> category; null -> null without playing; else playNotificationSound(category,prefs) and return the category). L421 trailing newline preserved.

Additive native-only export `nativeNotificationSoundCapabilities` (durablePrefsPersistenceAvailable / crossTabStorageEventAvailable / webAudioPlaybackAvailable all false `as const`) documents the explicit native-unavailable state per the conversion contract, mirroring nativeOnboardingSkipCapabilities; react-native-web may still light the real APIs up at runtime via the probes.
